summary: SafeDeal iteration-203 verification (backend + targeted frontend). NEW backend suite /app/backend/tests/test_safedeal_iter203.py = 12/12 PASS covering: (1) wallet response exposes available/held/total/currency at data.* top-level AND at data.wallet.* with identical values; (2) POST /api/safedeal/wallet/withdraw returns HTTP 201 and >$1000 → status='pending_approval', requires_approval=true, buyer available drops immediately; (3) post-funding action='cancel' → 'Cancellation requested' message + deal.status='disputed' with dispute_proposal.kind='cancellation', outcome='refund'; requester's own dispute-accept → 4xx; other party's dispute-accept → 'refunded' with buyer refund ≈ $300 (>250 & <318.30) and seller wallet unchanged; (4) full dispute negotiation flow: buyer opens split 40/60 → status=disputed/stage=negotiation → seller counters 60/40 (proposal.by=seller, split_percent_seller=60) → buyer posts dispute-message (thread grows) → buyer dispute-accept → status='split', seller>buyer and both credited; (5) super-admin POST /api/admin/login → accessToken works; GET /api/safedeal/admin/withdrawals?status=pending_approval lists the >$1000 row with customer_email; POST .../:id/approve → 200 with status='sent', simulated=true, tx_hash prefix 'SIMULATED-'; second approve → 409; POST .../:id/reject with reason → 200 status='rejected', seller available restored, statement contains kind='withdrawal_reversed' entry; unauthenticated admin route → 403; (6) GET /api/safedeal/admin/readiness → 200 with ready(bool), live_settlement=false, brand.company_id=262, 8 checks (keys=brand,url,live,wallets,custody,autoconvert,fees,email), brand.ok=fees.ok=true, wallets.ok=false, totals.customers=71 (>0), deals.count>0; (7) legacy /api/escrow/admin/deals still returns non-safedeal deals with invite_url containing '/escrow/invite/' (dealUrl recursion regression fix). Existing 11-test suite test_safedeal_api.py still 11/11 PASS. Frontend Playwright: SafeDeal buyer post-funding cancel-request flow verified end-to-end via UI — DisputePanel escrow-cancel-request-btn opens dialog with escrow-cancel-request-summary+message, submit yields toast 'Cancellation requested — waiting for the other party to agree.', deal data-status flips 'funded' → 'disputed', page shows 'Your cancellation request — awaiting their agreement', requester's own 'Agree to cancel' is disabled, and no 'DynoPay' misspelling on page. Admin /admin/escrow SafeDeal tab renders escrow-admin-readiness with state chip 'Setup incomplete', live chip 'Simulated settlement', all 4 tiles (customers=71, held=$1,241.65, available=$6,746.95, pending=1) and all 8 check rows with correct data-ok values (brand=1,url=1,live=1,wallets=0,custody=0,autoconvert=0,fees=1,email=1); wallets check text mentions 'No crypto wallets on the brand'; withdrawals tab has escrow-admin-wd-filter-pending_approval and -sent chips. safedeal.sh Host header emulation: `curl -H 'Host: safedeal.sh' http://localhost:3000/` = 200 containing sd-landing; /deals = 200 containing sd-deals-page; plain /deals (no Host) = 404 (as required).
